name: HaverCrown Dental
description: HaverCrown Dental on Eagle Road in Havertown offers preventive, cosmetic, and restorative dentistry, including implants, Invisalign, root canals, orthodontics, periodontics, and prosthodontics.
tagline: Preventive, cosmetic, and restorative dentistry on Eagle Road

hero.headline: Your best interests, on Eagle Road
hero.sub: A comprehensive selection of preventive, cosmetic, and restorative dentistry from a team of dentists at 100 S Eagle Rd in Havertown.

offerings.heading: Every specialty, <mark>one office.</mark>
items: General dentistry, cleanings, and preventive care for the family
Dental implants, root canals, orthodontics, periodontics, and prosthodontics
A team of dentists, not a single chair

story.heading: Why one office covers so much
paragraphs: HaverCrown Dental brought general dentists and specialists under one roof in Havertown, so an implant, a root canal, or braces do not mean a referral across the county.
The reviews describe the same thing from the patient side: a team that explains the plan and finishes it in the same building.

experience.heading: A visit at HaverCrown
items: Call to book; new patients start with an exam and a plan.
Specialty care scheduled in the same office when it is needed.
Financing through CareCredit for larger treatment.

feature.heading: Implants and prosthodontics
feature.text: Missing teeth are restored by the specialists on staff, from the implant to the crown, without leaving Eagle Road.

closing.heading: Preventive, cosmetic, and restorative dentistry in Havertown
